description: An attack and decay envelope in 2HP, with a curve control, an output scale that can invert, and a loop switch

params.text: Sets the attack time, 0 to 10 seconds
Sets the decay time, 0 to 10 seconds
Scales the envelope, -2 to +2, and turns it upside down at negative settings
Bends the two stages from straight lines towards exponential curves
Repeats the envelope, starting it again each time it finishes

inputs.text: A voltage added to the attack time; negative voltage subtracts from it
A voltage added to the decay time

outputs.text: A pulse when the envelope reaches the end of its decay
